profile.authorZh: 《风险之外：从项目现场、风险管理到企业安全治理》作者
profile.authorEn: Author of Beyond Risk: From Project Operations and Risk Management to Corporate Security Governance
expertiseZh: 高风险环境安保体系架构
企业安全治理与风险评估
expertiseEn: Corporate security governance and risk assessment

zh.headline: 安全体系，必须经得起现实检验。
zh.lead: 我为在敌对、不稳定及高威胁环境中运营的组织，设计和主导能够真正落地的安保体系。
zh.supporting: 15 年以上海外高风险环境实操与管理经验。重点涵盖关键目标防护、机动安全、军警协同、危机处置和安全治理。
zh.kicker: 风险识别之外，是执行能力。
zh.capabilitiesLead: 防护需求来自真实任务。安全设计围绕人员、设施、供应链与业务连续性展开，并落实到具体责任、资源和行动。
zh.researchLead: 围绕真实安全事件、战略演变、风险机制与企业决策展开的独立研究。
zh.monitoringLead: 追踪暴力事件、通行限制、监管变化与经营中断，直接回答对人员、路线和项目运营的影响。
zh.training: 敌对环境安全意识培训
zh.trainingLead: HEAT 课程、情境案例与判断训练。
zh.careerLead: 海外安全岗位与能力要求，聚焦相关行业和国际化业务。
zh.opsLead: 集团标准、区域执行、审核整改与承包商绩效的统一管理入口。
zh.connectTitle: 当安全成为业务的关键条件
zh.connectLead: 围绕实际项目，讨论安全架构、战略风险与执行方案。
zh.siteNote: 独立安全研究与风险治理 · 部分历史资料持续整理中。

en.headline: SECURITY BUILT FOR THE REAL WORLD.
en.lead: I design and lead security systems that work for organizations operating in hostile, unstable and high-threat environments.
en.supporting: Over 15 years of operational and leadership experience across high-risk overseas assignments, spanning protective security, movement planning, armed-force coordination, crisis response and risk governance.
en.capabilitiesLead: Security starts with operational realities. I connect people, facilities, supply chains and business continuity with clear responsibilities, resources and executable controls.
en.researchLead: Independent analysis of security incidents, strategic change, threat mechanisms and consequential management decisions.
en.monitoringLead: Tracking violence, movement restrictions, regulatory shifts and operational disruption with a focus on consequences for people, routes and projects.
en.trainingLead: HEAT modules, practical scenarios and decision exercises.
en.careerLead: International security roles and professional capability requirements.
en.opsLead: Group standards, regional execution, assessments, corrective actions and contractor performance.
en.connectLead: Discuss a real assignment involving security architecture, strategic risk or operational decisions.
en.siteNote: Independent security research and risk governance · Historical material is being curated.

articles.titleZh: BLA 战略演变与下一阶段意图评估
articles.titleEn: BLA strategic evolution and the implications for mining security
articles.excerptZh: 跟踪俾路支武装行动模式、战略重心及其对中国海外矿业投资的影响。
articles.excerptEn: A review of evolving militant activity, strategic priorities and implications for mining investment in Balochistan.

articles.titleZh: 巴基斯坦与刚果（金）矿业安全风险对比研究
articles.titleEn: Comparative security risks in Pakistan and the DRC
articles.excerptZh: 比较威胁结构、风险根源与两类矿业运营环境下的安保策略。
articles.excerptEn: Contrasting threat structures, root causes and protective strategies in two mining environments.

articles.titleZh: In Amenas 恐怖袭击：高风险能源项目的级联安保失效
articles.titleEn: In Amenas: Cascading security failures in high-risk energy projects
articles.excerptZh: 从多层防护与安全治理的失效传导过程，分析重大袭击事件对海外能源项目的启示。
articles.excerptEn: How failures across protective layers and governance systems compound into operational catastrophe.

articles.titleZh: 体系不是答案：安保的现实博弈与清醒边界
articles.titleEn: The system is not the answer
articles.excerptZh: 讨论现场压力之下，制度、判断与安全管理之间的真实关系。
articles.excerptEn: A field-driven perspective on systems, judgment and operational pressure.

events.titleZh: Kalemie–Bendera 公路伏击：两人死亡，一名中国公民遭绑架
events.titleEn: Kalemie–Bendera road ambush: two killed, Chinese national abducted
events.summaryZh: 11 月 14 日，Kalemie 通往 Bendera 的公路发生伏击，两人死亡、一名司机受伤，一名中国公民被带走。11 月 17 日当地媒体援引地方行政长官通报。
events.summaryEn: An ambush on the Kalemie–Bendera road on 14 November killed two people, wounded a driver and resulted in the abduction of a Chinese national, according to local reporting on 17 November.
events.actionZh: 重新审批该走廊非紧急出行，核查护卫能力、通信及医疗转运计划。
events.actionEn: Reassess non-essential travel on this corridor and verify escorts, communications and medical evacuation arrangements.

events.titleZh: Siguiri 非法采金整治：224 人获刑，跨境流动加剧
events.titleEn: Siguiri mining crackdown: 224 sentenced amid cross-border movement
events.summaryZh: 11 月 17 日报道称，Siguiri 法院对 202 名矿工和 22 名原地方官员作出判决，此前整治行动已引发致命冲突与跨境人口流动。
events.summaryEn: Reporting on 17 November described sentences for 202 miners and 22 former local officials following an enforcement campaign that triggered deadly clashes and cross-border movement.
events.actionZh: 核查矿点许可、供应商矿石来源、外包用工及周边社区风险。
events.actionEn: Review mine permits, suppliers, contractor exposure and affected border communities.

events.titleZh: 黑海 LPG 运输船 Gas Husky 沉没，19 名船员获救
events.titleEn: LPG carrier Gas Husky sinks in Black Sea; 19 crew rescued
events.summaryZh: 11 月 17 日，Gas Husky 在保加利亚 Byala 以东沉没，19 名船员全部获救。事故原因由主管部门调查。
events.summaryEn: The LPG carrier Gas Husky sank east of Byala, Bulgaria, with all 19 crew rescued. Authorities are investigating the cause.
events.actionZh: 核对航次、船况、保险条款及黑海港口替代能力。
events.actionEn: Review voyages, vessel condition, insurance terms and Black Sea port alternatives.

events.titleZh: 胡塞武装声称对沙特东西输油管道泵站发动无人机袭击
events.titleEn: Houthis claim drone attack on Saudi East–West Pipeline stations
events.summaryZh: 胡塞武装声称向两座泵站发射五架无人机。报道时设施实际损害情况未得到沙特方面确认。
events.summaryEn: Houthi forces claimed to have launched five drones toward two pumping stations. Saudi confirmation of facility damage was not reported at the time.
events.actionZh: 重点核查延布装船计划、管道实际流量与替代供应合同。
events.actionEn: Check Yanbu loading schedules, actual pipeline throughput and supply contingency clauses.
